meta.name: Dates & ardeh
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Moderate but narrow, and India-only. Genuine 2025-2026 foreign buy-side demand for Iranian Mazafati is real and steady on ExportersIndia buy-lead boards, but almost entirely from India (Hyderabad, Salem, Chennai, Nagpur, Kochi, Sangli, Amroha, Nalgonda), spanning 10 kg individual asks up to 1,000-10,000 kg bulk/urgent RFQs, with at least one registered fruit-trading firm and one recurring monthly buyer. Contacts are all masked behind an ExportersIndia login, so reachability is a real limitation. Critically, ZERO buyers for date cookies (koloocheh khormaei) or ardeh/tahini surfaced anywhere in this candidate set, so public-web foreign demand for those two products is thin/absent here; only Mazafati dates show meaningful traction, and only in the Indian import market.
